specs.name: Гоблин с дубинкой
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: one prone/defeated creature sprite for a classic tile-based fantasy roguelike, later processed locally to a native 64x64 AAP64 sprite.
Input images: Image 1 is the existing 64x64 gameplay sprite and is the identity and palette reference. Image 2 is the same creature's higher resolution source and is the equipment and anatomy reference.
Primary request: redraw this exact creature in a genuinely LYING DOWN / RECUMBENT pose. This must be a new anatomically natural pose, with a horizontal low silhouette and limbs resting on an implied floor; do not merely rotate, lean or stretch the upright sprite.
Style: match the existing old-school fantasy sprite design, chunky clean pixel-like shapes, dark purple/near-black outlines, simple coherent shading and limited color regions. Keep it readable when processed to 64x64. Avoid painterly texture, micro detail or realistic material rendering. Same three-quarter top-down camera as the existing roguelike sprite, now looking down onto the creature lying on its side.
Composition: EXACTLY ONE complete creature centered on a square transparent canvas, head to the LEFT and body to the RIGHT. The body lies flat, not sitting, crouching, kneeling, floating upright, or in an action pose. Full silhouette and all equipment fit well inside the canvas with modest transparent padding, no cropped parts.
Constraints: Preserve this exact creature's species, skin/bone/water color families, characteristic ears/head, armor/clothing, and equipment. Exactly the original number of limbs. Genuine transparent background. No floor, cast shadow, checkerboard drawn into the image, extra creature, text, numbers, labels, borders, watermark, blood, wounds or gore. No perspective scene or background.
Subject: The identical small olive-green goblin with long pointed ears, visible little fangs, brown sleeveless leather tunic, belt, brown boots, and ONE wooden club. It lies flat on its side with its head at the LEFT, body and legs extending to the RIGHT. Both arms rest down naturally, the wooden club rests beside and touches its hand, both legs are relaxed and lightly bent. Closed eyes and a neutral slack face.
